platform_claims_checked.claim: A Claude Code session running against that directory gets confused too. Its scrollback references files that no longer look the way it remembers.

The agent-level trap: if two sessions open the same working directory... the later write wins. The earlier session's in-progress edit gets clobbered on disk, its scrollback still references the old content, and the next turn goes sideways.
Open three Claude Code sessions, one per folder, one task each. Each session has its own scrollback, its own working directory, its own branch. They do not see each other.
Claude Code sessions keep their own conversational state. Git is what moves actual changes between them.
